question: What are the names of high schoolers who have a grade of over 5 and have 3 or more friends?
gold_query: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.id WHERE T2.grade > 5 GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*) >= 3
